curation.basis_zh: 最新全空间（426,555 候选）内部实验结果：每对含一个内部验证通过（validated：家族 FDR q≤0.05、|调整 Cohen d|≥0.15、留出方向 AUC≥0.55 且方向一致率≥0.7）与一个未通过的假设，前者冻结 ND 打分显著更高（差距 ≥0.20）。外部验证不参与本题库。文献面板：v1 人工复核卡片在假设重现时逐字复用，其余为知识图谱记录自动匹配（未逐条人工复核）。

literature_matching.basis: literature rematched from the KG claims layer on disease / region / measure / direction consistency; hypotheses are direction-free, so any definite reported direction counts as direction-consistent

blinding: Participants see frozen hypotheses and prior literature. Outcome sides, internal effect sizes and validation flags are stored only in the organizer truth file.

pairing_policy.outcomes: exactly one internally validated and one not validated
pairing_policy.same_task: same disease-versus-control contrast; atlas, ROI, and feature may differ
pairing_policy.difficulty: tertiles of the frozen NeuroDiscovery score gap; easy = largest gap

excerpts: Treatment-resistant schizophrenia (TRS) poses a considerable challenge in psychiatric care, with approximately 10-60% of patients exhibiting non-responsiveness to antipsychotic medication.

Leveraging data from multiple institutions spanning various continents and ethnic groups, our meta- and mega-analysis revealed a significant reduction in the volume of bilateral putamen and bilateral hippocampus, as well as the left superior frontal gyrus (SFG) surface area in TRS patients compared with non-TRS patients with sufficient statistical power.

literature.title: Subcortical volumes, frontal cortical thickness, and pro-inflammatory cytokines in schizophrenia versus methamphetamine-induced psychosis.
literature.authors: Blake Lauren, Williams Kimberley C, Uhlmann Anne A, Temmingh Henk, Burger Antoinette
excerpts: Schizophrenia is associated with alterations in subcortical volumes, cortical thickness and pro-inflammatory cytokines, that may correlate with clinical features.

Serum peripheral cytokine concentrations were measured using a multiplex bead array.Schizophrenia (n = 36) and methamphetamine-induced psychosis (n = 27) participants showed decreased left amygdala volumes and frontal cortical thickness compared to healthy controls (n = 32).

literature.journal: Journal of magnetic resonance imaging : JMRI
excerpts: Resting-fMRI white-matter analysis found never-treated schizophrenia had lower splenium corpus-callosum ALFF and decreased connectivity, while treated patients showed broader WM-GM correlation reductions.

literature.title: Functional Alterations of White Matter in Chronic Never-Treated and Treated Schizophrenia Patients.
literature.journal: Journal of magnetic resonance imaging : JMRI
excerpts: Resting-fMRI white-matter analysis found never-treated schizophrenia had lower splenium corpus-callosum ALFF and decreased connectivity, while treated patients showed broader WM-GM correlation reductions.

Never-treated patients demonstrated lower ALFF in splenium of corpus callosum relative to treated patients and controls, and the extracted independent component also located in the splenium showed significantly decreased connectivity in never-treated patients. The correlation coefficients of white matter and gray matter displayed greater reductions in treated patients in the genu, pontine crossing tract, cingulum, and corticospinal tract.

excerpts: Manual abstract curation: Drug-naive first-episode schizophrenia showed altered ALFF/fALFF/ReHo mainly in frontal lobe, putamen, globus pallidus, insula, cerebellum and PCC.

RESULTS: Eighteen eligible studies were included in this meta-analysis. Compared to the spontaneous brain activity of HCs, we found changes in spontaneous brain activity in Dn-FES based on these two methods, mainly including the frontal lobe, putamen, lateral globus pallidus, insula, cerebellum, and posterior cingulate cortex. CONCLUSION: We found that widespread abnormalities of spontaneous brain activity occur in the early stages of the onset of schizophrenia and may provide a reference for the early intervention of schizophrenia.
